name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly installments directly to bank accounts.
documents: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
application_process: Register on pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Complete Farmer Registration with Aadhaar e-KYC
Upload landholding details verified by Patwari/Revenue Officer
Track status using Aadhaar number on the PM-KISAN portal
overview: Central sector scheme launched to augment the income of all landholding farmers families across India.

name: Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत – प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
department: National Health Authority (NHA)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless health insurance coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalizations.
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Ration Card / BPL Card / SECC Household proof
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar / Revenue Authority
application_process: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in with mobile/Aadhaar
Visit nearest Empanelled Health Care Provider (EHCP) or CSC
Complete biometric e-KYC verification
Download Ayushman Gold Card instantly
overview: World’s largest government funded health assurance scheme covering over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.

name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin)
department: Department of Rural Development
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for pucca house construction, plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA wages.
documents: Aadhaar Card of Applicant and Spouse
Certificate of no pucca house ownership from Gram Panchayat
application_process: Gram Sabha shortlists eligible families based on Socio-Economic survey
Geo-tagging of current kutcha dwelling by Gram Rozgar Sahayak
Sanction order issued by Block Development Officer (BDO)
Installments released in 3 stages linked to construction milestones
overview: Provides financial assistance to rural houseless households and those living in dilapidated houses to construct pucca houses.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 Lakh (Shishu: up to ₹50k, Kishore: ₹50k–₹5L, Tarun: ₹5L–₹10L, Tarun Plus: ₹10L–₹20L) for micro & small enterprises.
documents: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
application_process: Apply online on Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any Commercial/Gramin Bank
Submit business project proposal and quotation of equipment
Loan processing and verification without collateral security
MUDRA Card issued with sanctioned credit limit
overview: Facilitates easy formal credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
documents: Project report of the proposed greenfield business
Proof of promoter holding at least 51% equity (for women/SC/ST)
Partnership deed / Memorandum of Association if applicable
application_process: Register on Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in)
Choose whether applying directly to bank or seeking handholding support from SIDBI/NABARD
Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Bank reviews and sanctions loan with CGSSI guarantee
overview: Promotes entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes for manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading activities.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
hindi_name: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: Direct central subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1kW, ₹60,000 for 2kW, and ₹78,000 for 3kW or higher rooftop solar systems, generating up to 300 units of free electricity monthly.
documents: Latest Electricity Bill with Consumer Account Number (CA)
Aadhaar Card of Electricity Connection Holder
Cancelled Cheque / Bank Passbook for subsidy crediting
Proof of Rooftop Space / House Ownership
application_process: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in selecting your state and DISCOM
Apply for rooftop solar plant installation
Installation carried out by registered DISCOM vendor
Net meter installed and inspected; subsidy credited to bank in 30 days
overview: Flagship renewable energy initiative to illuminate 1 crore Indian households with free rooftop solar power.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees plus monthly maintenance allowance of up to ₹1,200 to ₹3,500/month depending on course degree.
documents: Caste / Community Certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate
Bonafide Student Certificate and Fee Receipt from Institute
application_process: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Select Post Matric Scholarship scheme under Ministry of Social Justice
Upload institute fee structure, caste certificate, and academic records
Verification by Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and District Welfare Officer
overview: Provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste and backward class students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
hindi_name: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति
department: Department of Higher Education
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for graduation (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per annum for post-graduation courses for meritorious students.
documents: Class 12th Board Marksheet (Scored above 80th percentile in relevant stream)
Bonafide Admission Certificate in regular degree college/university
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
application_process: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Enter Class 12 Roll Number and Passing Year to verify percentile cutoff
Submit College Bonafide and parental income certificate
Scholarship disbursed via DBT directly to student account
overview: Aids meritorious students from low-income families to meet part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC)
application_process: Apply online on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through Banking Correspondents
Verify Urban Local Body vending survey record or request LoR
Choose preferred lending institution (Public/Private Bank or MFI)
Loan disbursed within 7-10 working days
overview: Special micro-credit facility empowering urban street vendors to resume their livelihood and climb credit ladders.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, basic & advanced skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 Lakh at concessional 5% interest.
documents: Self-declaration of practicing one of 18 traditional artisan trades
application_process: Enrol at any Common Service Centre (CSC) with biometric verification
Three-tier verification: Gram Panchayat/ULB, District Implementation Committee, National Committee
Receive Vishwakarma Digital ID and 5-7 days skill training
Toolkit incentive credited to e-RUPI and loan sanction
overview: Holistic support for artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 traditional trades to scale their products and market reach.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Free deposit-free LPG connection, first LPG cylinder refill free of cost, and hotplate (stove) to adult women from BPL/poor households.
estimated_benefit_amount: Free LPG Connection + First Refill + Stove (~₹3,600 value)
documents: Aadhaar Card of adult woman applicant (proof of identity and address)
Ration Card issued by State Govt / Family composition self-declaration
application_process: Apply online on pmuy.gov.in or submit form at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, BharatGas, HP Gas)
Submit family composition declaration
Verification of no prior LPG connection in the household
LPG connection issued under woman’s name
overview: Provides clean cooking fuel like LPG to rural and deprived households to protect women and child health.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 until death, followed by pension to spouse, and return of corpus to nominee.
documents: Savings Bank Account with auto-debit facility
application_process: Visit your Bank branch or apply via NetBanking/Mobile Banking
Choose desired pension amount (₹1k to ₹5k) and auto-debit frequency (monthly/quarterly)
Acknowledge Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) generation
Monthly contributions auto-debited until age 60
overview: Universal social security scheme for all Indians, especially targeted at unorganised workers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first child and ₹6,000 in single installment on birth of a second girl child to compensate for wage loss.
documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card registered with Anganwadi/Health Centre
Bank Account details of pregnant woman
application_process: Register at Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in
Submit Form 1A within 570 days of LMP (Last Menstrual Period)
Complete at least one antenatal checkup (ANC)
Benefit credited directly to mother’s Aadhaar-seeded bank account
overview: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers for improved health and nutrition.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Department of Economic Affairs
benefits: High guaranteed interest rate (8.2% p.a.) with Section 80C tax exemption for savings dedicated to a girl child’s higher education and marriage.
documents: Identity and Address proof of Guardian/Parent (Aadhaar/PAN)
Passport size photograph of child and parent
application_process: Visit any Post Office or authorised commercial bank branch
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form
Submit girl child birth certificate and KYC documents
Passbook issued with account details; deposits accepted until 15 years from opening
overview: Government small-deposit scheme designed to secure the financial future of girl children in India.

name: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of up to 35% on manufacturing projects up to ₹50 Lakh and service sector projects up to ₹20 Lakh for self-employment generation.
estimated_benefit_amount: Up to 35% margin money subsidy (up to ₹17.5 Lakh)
documents: Education qualification certificate (Minimum 8th pass for projects > ₹10 Lakh)
application_process: Apply online on the kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal
District Task Force Committee (DTFC) reviews and forwards to financing bank
Bank sanctions loan and disburses first tranche
Subsidy kept as term deposit for 3 years, then credited to project account
overview: Major credit-linked subsidy programme to generate continuous employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
department: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Free industry-aligned short term skill training, National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) certification, assessment fee waiver, and placement assistance.
estimated_benefit_amount: 100% Free Training + NSQF Certification + Placement support
application_process: Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in)
Explore certified courses in electronics, IT, healthcare, automotive, green energy, etc.
Enroll in nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK)
Complete training and pass independent third-party NSQF assessment
overview: Enables Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that helps them secure a better livelihood.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
hindi_name: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
department: Department of Rural Development
benefits: Monthly social pension (₹200 to ₹500 from Centre + State top-up up to ₹1,000–₹3,000/month depending on state) for destitute senior citizens.
documents: Bank Account / Post Office Account passbook
application_process: Submit application at Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / Municipal Ward office
Verification of age and BPL status by local revenue authority
Sanction by Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO)
Direct monthly credit to beneficiary account
overview: Non-contributory monthly pension providing social protection to elderly living below poverty line.

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana (NHFDC Concessional Loan)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Concessional loans up to ₹50 Lakh at low interest rates (5% to 8% p.a.) with 0.5% special rebate for women with disabilities for self-employment ventures.
documents: UDID (Unique Disability ID) Card or Disability Certificate (40% or above)
application_process: Apply online on nhfdc.nic.in or through State Channelising Agency (SCA) / Regional Rural Bank
Verification of disability certificate and project feasibility
Loan disbursed with subsidised interest rate and moratoriam period
overview: Financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) for starting or scaling viable income-generating business projects.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / NABARD
benefits: Short-term credit for crop cultivation and farm maintenance up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of only 4% (7% base minus 3% prompt repayment incentive).
estimated_benefit_amount: Up to ₹3,00,000 crop loan @ 4% effective interest
documents: Land Record copy (Khatauni / Jamabandi / 7-12) showing cultivable land
Declaration of crops sown / proposed to be cultivated
No-dues certificate from nearby financial institutions
application_process: Download simplified one-page KCC application form from bank or pmkisan.gov.in
Submit to the bank branch where PM-KISAN or savings account is held
Bank issues KCC smart card / ATM card within 14 days
overview: Simplifies institutional credit access for farmers to purchase seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and cover harvesting expenses.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks at very low farmer premium rates (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops).
estimated_benefit_amount: Full insured crop loss indemnity coverage
application_process: Apply online on National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) or at nearest CSC / Bank
Pay nominal premium before cut-off date
In case of localized calamity or prevented sowing, report claim within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App
overview: Protects farmers from financial loss caused by unforeseen weather events, pests, and natural disasters.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
hindi_name: बेगम हज़रत महल राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति योजना
department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation
benefits: Scholarship of ₹6,000 for Class 9th & 10th and ₹12,000 for Class 11th & 12th for girl students belonging to notified minority communities.
documents: School verification certificate signed by Principal
Self-declaration of minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Previous class marksheet with minimum 50% marks
application_process: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Submit educational details and upload school verification form
Amount credited via DBT directly to student account
overview: Recognizes and assists meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities to continue schooling.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹20 Lakh as grant for proof of concept/prototype development, and up to ₹50 Lakh for market entry/commercialization through convertible debentures.
estimated_benefit_amount: Up to ₹20 Lakh grant + ₹50 Lakh debt investment
documents: DPIIT Recognition Certificate of the Startup
Business Plan / Pitch Deck with proof of innovative idea
Company Incorporation Certificate (incorporated within last 2 years)
Details of promoter holding at least 51% equity
application_process: Apply online on seedfund.startupindia.gov.in
Select up to 3 approved incubators in order of preference
Incubator Seed Management Committee evaluates presentation and awards funds
Milestone-based fund disbursement
overview: Provides early-stage capital to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market-entry.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 in case of death of the insured due to any cause at an annual premium of just ₹436.
documents: Consent form for auto-debit of ₹436 annual premium
application_process: Enable auto-debit through NetBanking or visit your bank branch
Submit simple self-declaration of good health
Insurance cover renews automatically on 1st June every year
overview: One-year renewable life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh coverage for all bank account holders.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Accidental death and permanent full disability cover of ₹2,00,000 (and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability) at a nominal premium of just ₹20 per year.
application_process: Enroll online via your mobile banking app or at any bank / post office
Premium of ₹20 is auto-debited in May every year
Immediate 24x7 coverage against accidental hazards
overview: Most affordable accident insurance scheme for all citizens aged 18 to 70 years.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free distribution of assisted living devices (hearing aids, walking sticks, wheelchairs, spectacles, artificial dentures) for senior citizens from low income families.
documents: Proof of Age (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age 60+)
BPL Card / Income Certificate (family income below ₹1.5 - ₹1.8 Lakh)
Medical assessment certificate by ALIMCO / District Medical Officer
application_process: Attend free assessment camp conducted by ALIMCO and District Social Welfare Office
Physical screening for age-related disabilities
Devices custom fitted and handed over at official distribution camp
overview: Provides physical aids and assisted living devices for senior citizens suffering from age-related disabilities.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Government shares 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500/month per apprentice directly to the apprentice’s bank account via DBT during on-the-job industrial training.
estimated_benefit_amount: Monthly stipend support up to ₹1,500 + Industry experience
documents: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar (DBT active)
application_process: Register as candidate on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
Complete profile with e-KYC and resume details
Apply to apprenticeship vacancies posted by leading public and private enterprises
Sign digital apprenticeship contract upon selection
overview: Promotes apprenticeship training and incentives for youth to acquire hands-on industry skills.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (National Rural Livelihoods Mission)
hindi_name: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन (SHG)
department: Department of Rural Development
benefits: Revolving fund of ₹15,000 and Community Investment Fund of up to ₹2.5 Lakh to Women Self Help Groups (SHGs) plus interest subvention for loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 7% p.a.
estimated_benefit_amount: Revolving Fund + Interest Subvention on loans up to ₹3 Lakh
application_process: Join or form a local Self Help Group (SHG) with 10-20 rural women
Participate in weekly savings and internal lending for 3 months
Apply for Revolving Fund and bank linkage through Village Organization (VO)
Receive skill training and subsidized enterprise credit
overview: Organizes rural poor women into Self-Help Groups and continuously supports them until they achieve self-sustaining livelihoods.

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (State Health Scheme)
department: Department of Medical, Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless healthcare treatment coverage of up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year in empanelled private and government hospitals for all eligible residents.
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Receipt
Aadhaar Card of all family members
application_process: Automatic for NFSA / BPL / Small Farmers through Jan Aadhaar database
Others register at e-Mitra or SSO Rajasthan portal paying nominal annual premium
Present Jan Aadhaar at hospital Helpdesk for instant cashless admission
overview: Pioneering universal health assurance scheme by Government of Rajasthan covering critical illnesses and hospitalizations.
